verdict.rationale: Elastic documents self-managed deployment 'anywhere: on-prem or in private or public cloud,' with a Docker quickstart and a trial license that 'includes all Elasticsearch features.' Community users confirm running it on Kubernetes via the ECK operator or StatefulSets. Parity with the hosted product is not shown: proprietary add-ons sit behind paid licenses, and Serverless capabilities such as autoscaling, separated search/index tiers and cross-project search are documented only for Elastic-managed projects. Missing for 10: documented feature parity between self-managed and hosted/Serverless, full feature set on self-hosted without a paid or trial license, and first-party production self-managed deployment docs in the pack.

support.subject: As a platform-engineer, I can self-host the full engine — same features as the hosted product — on my own infrastructure
